data.title: 杏山和纱 · 甜点残香后的猫耳偏首
data.action: 侧身靠着懒人沙发，尾巴在羊毛毯上轻轻晃动，单手把玩着马卡龙缎带，猫耳微微抖动，偏过通红的脸轻哼，余光却悄悄黏在来人身上。
data.location: 点缀着小彩灯的温馨单间，矮几上放着吃了一半的马卡龙盒与红茶杯
data.timeOfDay: 深夜放学后的秘密私语
data.lighting: 暖粉色与琥珀色的小彩灯提供主环境光，柔化了少女傲娇的神态轮廓

data.description: 点缀着小彩灯的温馨单间，矮几上放着吃了一半的马卡龙盒与红茶杯。侧身靠着懒人沙发，尾巴在羊毛毯上轻轻晃动，单手把玩着马卡龙缎带，猫耳微微抖动，偏过通红的脸轻哼，余光却悄悄黏在来人身上。 她微微抬眸轻语——“喂……别总是一脸傻样地盯着我看啊。吃完甜点……就快点过来陪我吹头发啦。”
data.promptProse: Seated cross-legged on a fluffy bedroom rug beside a low wooden table holding an open box of macarons and a teacup, Kazusa wears her smoky mauve-and-grey lace camisole and ruffled lounge shorts. Toying with a ribbon from the pastry box while glancing away with a flustered crimson blush, she keeps one shy sidelong eye on the viewer beneath twinkling amber and rose fairy lights.
data.animaCaption: Seated cross-legged on the rug beside half-eaten macarons and tea in her smoky mauve-and-grey lace camisole and ruffled shorts, Kazusa turns away with a flustered blush and shy sidelong glance. Warm twinkling fairy lights glow softly behind her.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a smoky mauve-and-grey lace-trimmed camisole with a subtle cat-ear notched neckline and satin ribbon bows paired with ruffled tap-pant shorts, baring her shoulders and legs.
